aboutText: Based in Niddrie, Landscape Construction Melbourne has been delivering expert landscape construction services across Melbourne for years. We specialise in creating outdoor spaces with strong foundations and precise results, from retaining walls to complete garden makeovers. Our team is committed to bringing your vision to life with quality craftsmanship.
servicesText: We offer a full range of landscape construction services in Niddrie and across Melbourne, including design, installation, and maintenance. Our experienced team handles projects of all sizes, ensuring high-quality results tailored to your outdoor space.

services.title: Landscape Design & Construction
services.desc: We create custom designs and manage the entire construction process to build stunning outdoor spaces in Niddrie.

services.title: Retaining Wall Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of retaining walls to manage slopes and enhance the durability and aesthetics of your garden.

services.title: Garden Makeovers
services.desc: Transform your garden with new plants, features, and layouts that reflect your style and needs.

services.title: Hardscaping & Paving
services.desc: Install paths, driveways, and outdoor areas using durable materials for long-lasting functionality and appeal.

services.title: Outdoor Living Areas
services.desc: Design and build patios, decks, and entertainment spaces perfect for relaxing or hosting in Melbourne.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep and maintenance services to keep your garden vibrant and well-maintained year-round.
